# Alessandro Balbina

> Ph.D. Student in Economics and Business at the University of Cagliari (UniCa), specializing in Tourism Economics, Artificial Intelligence in Tourism, and Sustainable Destination Management.

## Overview & Academic Identity
Alessandro Balbina is an Italian academic researcher and doctoral student (Cycle XLI, 2024–Present) at the Department of Economics and Business Sciences, University of Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy. His research investigates the impact of generative artificial intelligence on tourism business models, tourist decision-making and adoption of conversational AI, digital transformation of local tourism SMEs, and human-centered management.

- **Current Position:** Ph.D. Student in Economics and Business (41st Cycle, 2024–Present)
- **Institution:** Department of Economics and Business Sciences, University of Cagliari, Sardinia, Italy
- **Primary Research Domains:** Tourism Economics, Artificial Intelligence in Tourism, Sustainable Destination Management, SME Digital Transformation, Data Analytics
- **Methodological Approaches:** Qualitative & quantitative surveys, spatial analysis, econometric modeling, text mining & NLP on tourism reviews
